summary: Close the source iterator if a known Array.from mapper or result write completes abruptly.

semantics.close_method: dynamic return lookup per canonical iterator contract where applicable

tests.name: mapper throw closes
tests.input: let closed=false; const x={*[Symbol.iterator](){try{yield 1;yield 2}finally{closed=true}}}; try{Array.from(x,()=>{throw 'x'})}catch{} console.log(closed);

tests.name: success exhausts normally
tests.input: let closed=false; const x={*[Symbol.iterator](){try{yield 1}finally{closed=true}}}; Array.from(x,x=>x); console.log(closed);
tests.expected_behavior: prints true after normal generator exhaustion
